title: The Floral Palace
intro: Palace doors in teal and gold, garlanded in pink. They open on the ring ceremony, the two names, the date in an envelope, and the way to the venue.
included: Palace doors that open on the first tap
A welcome from the parents, by name
The date sealed in an envelope, saved to the calendar in one tap
Venue with a map, labelled in your own script
Your names set over the artwork, nothing repainted
